title: podman farm list doesn't show builder platform support
body:
### Feature request description

When using podman farm list, builders don't show what platforms they support

```
# podman farm list
Name        Connections              Default     ReadWrite
testfarm    [steph.firstyear.id.au]  true        true
```

This should show that the supported platform for this builder is "freebsd/amd64". Similar linux and other architectures should list what platforms they support. 

I have found no command that lets me display what a connection supports platform wise.

comments.body: A friendly reminder that this issue had no activity for 30 days.
Hey, I’ll start looking into this issue now. I was tied up with the Buildah PR over the past couple of weeks, which is why I wasn’t able to make progress on this earlier.

Hey @Firstyear, I wanted to clarify the expected output for `podman farm list` before I start working on the implementation.

I can think of two possible scenarios:

**Scenario 1: A farm contains builders with multiple architectures.**  
Since there's no fixed limit on the number of builders in a farm, displaying every builder's architecture in a single column could make the output cluttered. In this case, would it make sense to display the set of unique architectures available in the farm, or would you prefer a different approach?

**Scenario 2: Farms are generally organized by architecture.**  
If each farm typically contains builders with the same architecture, or only a small number of distinct architectures, displaying the architecture information would be much more straightforward.

For Scenario 1, what would you consider the ideal output? Should we list all unique architectures in the farm, display them another way, or take a different approach altogether?

I just wanted to get your thoughts on the expected behavior before diving into the implementation. Thanks!
